description: Least privilege for the main window (security model T10). It may read, identify, connect (check with the provider, then save) and remove provider keys, see and switch the provider-side tools the core offers, read runs' traces and take the run a click in the corral asked to open, see each agent's policy and save one the core checked, see each agent's name, model and cap and save them once the core checked them, sign in to and out of a ChatGPT plan through the browser and open its Manage usage page (ADR-017), and nothing else. Add single permissions per feature, never bundles; keep tests/capabilities.rs in step.
